title: Jian Dao Mei Nu Jian Xian Hou Wo Ni Xi Le

overview: The 1990s. Alexey Kirsanov, an investigator at the Smolensk Regional Prosecutor's Office, receives a "black mark" from the leader of a local organized crime group without a statute of limitations, and a hunt begins for him. Kirsanov's close friend and colleague, Igor Sazonov, is being promoted and transferred to the position of prosecutor of the Yaroslavl region. He offers Kirsanov to move to a new place with him, away from gang violence.
title: Число зверя

overview: Heartwarming comedy following the lives of the large, close-knit and dysfunctional Lewis family from Birkenhead, Merseyside.
title: Being Eileen

overview: The series follows two families from very different sides of the tracks whose lives are slowly entangled by the actions of saintly but strung-out cleaner Maria.
title: Santa Maria

overview: Vandaag Inside Oranje is a special edition of Vandaag Inside dedicated entirely to the World Cup. The regular panelists discuss the matches, notable events, and the dutch national team's performance. The show also covers other topics that are making headlines at the time.
title: Vandaag Inside Oranje

overview: A mysterious vampire novelist uses his supernatural powers to solve complex crimes alongside a rookie editor, slowly regaining his lost humanity through their bond.
title: The Author I Admired was not Human

overview: Follows the journey of Selim Al-Ansary, a hardworking police officer, who was wrongly accused of murder.
title: Kalabsh

overview: Ride along as officers face the dangers and decisions that define the night shift.
title: Late Night Law

overview: What he sees as duty, she sees as control, and what begins as protection slowly turns into a silent war between a responsible man and an unwilling heart
title: Muhafiz

overview: Hit Man, a series inspired by the 2024 AGC Studios feature that was co-written, produced and headlined by Glen Powell.
title: Hit Man

overview: Suzuki is a self-proclaimed loner secretly writing stories about the popular boy, Serizawa. But when their worlds collide, Serizawa finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Suzuki, turning fiction into reality.
title: Yokya Shudan ni iru Serizawa wa, Ore no Mae da to Yosu ga Okashii

overview: In a luxury house, everything is arranged for a comfortable life: spacious rooms, a warm pool, a well-groomed territory... And most importantly, there is money in the house! The bank is replenished every day thanks to the joint efforts of the participants. There is only one way to break this impressive jackpot — to successfully leave the house. Whichever player does it first, the entire budget will be transferred to that account. All entrances and exits, windows and any possible loopholes in the house are securely closed, which means that the participants will not just have to look for a way to freedom, but build a subtle strategy. Interestingly, the smart home itself is also a full-fledged hero of the project. He can ironically communicate with the characters at breakfast and challenge them during the trials.
title: Идеальное ограбление

overview: Ten years ago, the life of operative Sergei Granin changed dramatically when he was seriously injured while rescuing his friend and partner Yuri Dymov. During the time the law enforcement officer was in the hospital, his wife Maria went to Dymov and took their eight-year-old daughter with her. Disappointed in his family and people in general, Granin leaves for a remote village, where he becomes an inspector of forest protection and receives the nickname Leshiy for his unsociability. In his new position, Granin does not sit idle and helps the local district police officer Karpen in solving cases. This attracts the attention of the new chief of police, who turns out to be Dymov, who was transferred here from St. Petersburg. Now the former partners have to cross paths with each other while investigating crimes, the traces of which often lead to the forest surrounding the village of Ostrov from all sides. Granin's ex-wife and daughter, who arrived with Dymov, prevent him from focusing on finding criminals. It is difficult for the hero to find a common language with the child, and the end of the relationship with his wife has not been reached.…
title: Леший

overview: The Arsenio Hall Show, hosted by comedian and actor Arsenio Hall, will feature a mix of comedy, music and celebrity guests, bringing a fresh new perspective to the late-night scene. The daily, one-hour nationally syndicated late-night talk show is anchored by the Tribune Broadcasting station group.
title: The Arsenio Hall Show

overview: In Rosa Elettrica, Rosa Valera is a young agent recently transferred to the Witness Protection Unit. On her first assignment, she's assigned to Cocìss, an unpredictable Camorra baby-boss who recently repented. Having been targeted by the rival clan, the young man has agreed to cooperate with the police to save his own skin. Rosa wonders why she was chosen, but she doesn't have time to let her uncertainties hold her back. Determined to protect Cocìss at all costs, she doesn't stop even when she realizes there's a flaw in the system and that, not only is her career at risk, but her life as well. Alone against the odds, Rosa and Cocìss escape together, driven by a common goal: to save their own skin and uncover the truth.
title: Rosa Elettrica
Dong Bei Ai Qing Wang Shi: Shan Hun Mei Gui

overview: He took the world by storm in the London Summer Games, and in "What Would Ryan Lochte Do?", the all-American swimming phenom proves that he lives life just like he swims ... all out and at top speed. The new series shines a whole new light on the sexy superstar swimmer as Lochte's friendships, love life and family dynamic take center stage for all the world to see. And since this 'athlebrity' pushes each aspect of his life to the highest level, Lochte's unpredictable, unfiltered and delightfully uninhibited "Lochteisms" -- those remarks, phrases and concepts that catch us completely off-guard and for which he has already become legend -- are going to have people texting and tweeting from coast to coast.
title: What Would Ryan Lochte Do?

overview: A globe-trotting journey through international pride festivals reveals diverse LGBTQ+ communities and their historical legacies across cultures and continents.
title: Pride

overview: Alex Nickel (Technicality) was born in 2001. Join him as he discovers, reacts to, and explains pop-culture from the late 1990s and early 2000s.
title: Alex Goes Bananas

overview: Stories of great urban planning and urban experiences from Amsterdam and the Netherlands. It's not just bikes.
title: Not Just Bikes

overview: RealLifeLore explains the history, geography, undercurrents and geopolitics of international disputes both big and small around the globe with the occasional diversions off planet or into 'that seems weird" situations that are quite telling.
title: Real Life Lore

overview: The Dumping Ground's residents face challenges every day, but nothing is impossible when they work together.
title: The Dumping Ground

overview: Without money, without a partner and over 40, Miguel finds himself at a crossroads. However, his charisma and success with older women leads his friends at the health club to convince him to make a living as an escort for older ladies. With them, Miguel learns and enjoys himself, offering attention, joy and plenty of fun in return.
title: Adónis

overview: The Coral Triangle is a tropical area located in the Pacific Ocean, where Southeast Asia (China Sea) and Oceania meet. It is the place with the most marine biodiversity of the planet. For two years, the award-winning Spanish underwater cameraman, Álex del Olmo, has travelled around the Coral Triangle, filming the marine fauna and the vast array of coral that inhabits the spectacular reefs of this area, the true lung of our planet. With a neat 4K image, the 8 episodes of the series cover places such as the Forgotten Islands, Raja Ampat, Komodo, Bali, Triton Bay, Flores, among others, to show in detail dozens of species of fish and crustaceans, captured with macro lenses.
title: Into the Blue: Las maravillas del Triángulo de Coral

overview: The young adult rom-com centers on 18-year-old competitive swimmer Trixie, whose home is her father's swimming pool. However, the pool is on the verge of bankruptcy and is therefore rented out to a group of wannabe mermaids, whom Trixie now has to tolerate in her waters. Sixteen-year-old Instagram star and crowd-pleaser Finn is part of this group, and he manages to make Trixie's steely heart beat faster. Will the athlete and the merman be able to admit that they're on the same wavelength?
title: Mermaids to Lovers

overview: Cha Myung Jo works at a company producing imitation character stickers. Though he's technically the head of his household, at home he's constantly overshadowed by his highly competent wife, who's a judge. However, when Myung-jo comes to create a counterfeit bill so flawless it can't be distinguished from the real thing, he steps into an unexpected world he never imagined.
title: Paper Man

overview: A-Deng, a lantern bearer who has lost her memory, wanders the mortal world carrying a bronze soul lantern. There, she encounters Xie Jingchen, the General of Dingyuan, who is burdened by a long-standing injustice that has plagued his family. Together, they investigate a series of supernatural mysteries, including the vengeful spirits haunting the Liu Manor and eerie disturbances within frontier military camps. As they unravel these cases, they gradually uncover the long-buried truth behind a devastating war between humans and demons that took place three centuries ago. A-Deng and Ying, whose heart has been consumed by obsession and resentment, are revealed to be twin souls split from the divine spirit of the Creator God. Meanwhile, the Xie family has for generations carried the sacred duty of protecting the soul lantern, while Qin Chong, the empire's powerful Chancellor, is exposed as the hidden leader of the demon clan living among humans. After a thousand years of misunderstanding, Ying and A-Deng finally reconcile. However, Ying sacrifices herself to seal away an ancient evil threatening all realms. In the end, A-Deng and Xie Jingchen restore peace to the empire and set out on a journey across the three realms, carrying fragments of Ying's remaining soul in search of a way to reunite her spirit.
title: Maiden and Shadow

overview: Edwin Edwards, now 86 years old and still dubbed the "King of Louisiana," shocked the state (and his family) when he married Trina Grimes Scott, a woman 50 years his junior. They became pen pals while Edwin was serving an 8 1/2 year prison sentence for bribery and extortion - charges stemming from his tenure as Governor of Louisiana - and married when Edwin was released. This colorful couple heads a newly combined family comprised of Edwin's daughters: Anna, a 63-year-old, four-time divorcée and Victoria, a seen-it-all former performer who is never far from her electronic cigarette, as well as Trina's sons from a previous marriage, 16-year-old Logan and 14-year-old Trevor.
title: The Governor's Wife

overview: Ancient Greece is known as the birthplace of democracy, science, and architecture, but a darker reality hides beyond the shiny marble façade. This five-part series shows another side of Greek history, including menacing gods, oppressive laws, and brutal wars.
title: Ancient Greece: The Dark Chronicles

overview: Vocal is a TNT game show in which the stars will have to test their hearing, intuition and ability to recognize the voices of colleagues. The participants are divided into two teams and try to figure out who is singing in front of them now — the real star or her vocal double. The main task of the players is to confuse their rivals and not fall for the tricks of impersonators who can perfectly copy famous voices. Alexey Vorobyov became the host of the project, and among the participants were Philip Kirkorov, Olga Buzova, Klava Coca, Valeria, Irina Dubtsova, Lucy Chebotina, Marina Kravets, Timur Rodriguez and many other stars. In each round, teams earn money for their vocal counterparts — with each game, the stakes get higher and the mistake gets more expensive. The winner is the one who can keep his cool, recognize deception and not let his rivals confuse him.
title: Игра вслепую

overview: Come Outside is an educational series for children. Auntie Mabel and Pippin the dog explore the world around - on the ground, under the ground and sometimes up in the air, in Auntie's aeroplane.
title: Come Outside

overview: Incredible Crew is a live-action, half-hour, sketch comedy series from producer and entertainer Nick Cannon. Every episode of this high-energy, fast-paced show delivers hilarious comedy bits, outrageous hidden camera pranks, original music videos and commercial parodies all with a distinct attitude - a contemporary blend of internet sensibility mixed with kid imagination.
title: Incredible Crew

overview: Armenian soldiers' heroics during Artsakh wars through personal stories, battlefield bravery, and human experiences, highlighting their sacrifices, love, struggles, and how their legacy lives on, underscoring the cost of freedom.
title: Legacy of Heroes

overview: What happens when straight dudes get picked off the street and get boobed up for cash? Come hang with Jimbo on KNOCKERS!
title: Knockers

overview: A young daughter supports her father who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.
title: Beautiful Rain

overview: The main characters of the series are two pairs of parents of spouses Ania and Mateusz. The young people go on holidays bought last minute and want to leave their 7-year-old daughter, Maja, in the care of their grandparents. As a result of a mistake, both Ania's parents from the countryside and Mateusz's parents, who live in the big city, come to look after their granddaughter.
title: Swaci

overview: Told through the eyes of Su Man, a young woman from Taipei, China, this warm, uplifting, and lightly comedic series follows her unexpected journey. Unemployed and broke after her ex-boyfriend empties their joint savings, Su Man travels to Lucheng to demand repayment. Instead, she ends up with a restaurant, all that's left of the debt. Selling it isn't easy, so her actuary logic kicks in: run the business, raise its value, then sell. On the other side of town, Chen Yu, a Michelin chef chasing the essence of great food, returns to Lucheng and stumbles into Su Man's life through that very storefront. Together, they start an unlikely partnership running a cozy neighborhood eatery at No. 99 Xingfu Road. They whip up comforting dishes for the city's tireless workers. Through cooking and keeping each other company day by day, they go from clash to connection, from going it alone to leaning on each other. As the street fills with savory smells and laughter, the old neighborhood regains its pulse. In this simple yet profound journey, both find the flavor of happiness once again.
title: No.99,Happiness Road

overview: A miracle doctor whose entire family was slaughtered, Yang Yunfan returns with amnesia and storms into Qijiang City as a dark horse, only to be swept into the power struggles of the Xuan Medical Association's rival families. Entangled with a domineering CEO, Ye Qingxue, a gentle and delicate pharmacist, Lu Tanxiang, and a beautiful assassin, Lin Hongxiu, can he unravel the mystery of his own past?
title: Trial of Healer

overview: As Shicheng City rises with the logistics boom, gang violence spreads across the city. Undercover officer Ling Che is forced to partner with street hustler Shen Yanlin. What begins as a clash of enemies slowly turns into an unbreakable bond. But as they dig deeper, betrayal emerges from within and corruption runs through the police force. When loyalty becomes a weapon and justice becomes a bargaining chip, a deadly battle between right and wrong is about to unfold...
title: The Underworld

overview: While investigating Meiyan International's raw material fraud, Su Li's involved in an accident and wakes up with amnesia. Mistaken for Gu Qingmei, the He family's meek daughter-in-law who happens to look exactly like her, she's swept into a world of wealth and secrets. Teaming up with Mu Shaoze, who's seeking revenge, they dig deeper and uncover a conspiracy bigger than they ever imagined.
title: Inherently Kind

overview: The series follows a young group of elite nannies, who head to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.
title: Million Dollar Nannies

overview: Perfect Score, hosted by fan-favorite actress Arielle Kebbel, puts a unique twist on dating game shows by not only giving players a chance to win a date, but also the opportunity to win cold hard cash -- IF they can successfully identify their perfect match. In each half-hour episode, two friends compete to see who can pick their ideal mate from a group of 12 prospective singles, after both the players and the contestants have taken compatibility tests. These tests are used to assign cash values to each possible match, and the player who selects the most compatible single - with the highest cash value - wins the cash prize and the date!
title: Perfect Score

overview: Also on Crave and Prime Video, mini-series, only one season
title: Sortez-moi de moi

overview: Bai Che, a death-scene cleanup worker, discovers his adoptive father's mysterious death at a job site. Black-market organ trade messages soon appear, and a break-in at his home makes him realize he is also in danger. Zhou Chen, who claims to be an organ donation coordinator, comes to him and begins uncovering the dark truth behind organ trafficking, gang forces, and hidden secrets about Bai Che's identity. As the mastermind behind the case closes in, the two men can only rely on each other through betrayal and pursuit.
title: Unfold
Familiegeheimen: Het ware gelaat van Joris

overview: Depicts the story of Gui Ming, a young man who found himself in a parallel world as an Omega in the ABO world. Not only married to his Alpha's arch-enemy but... also conceived his child? Since then, Gui Ming's life began, and the tug-of-war of love during the ten months of pregnancy began...
title: Couple or Not

overview: Setting the Tempo takes audiences inside the exhilarating, high-stakes process of building a WNBA franchise from the ground up. Led by an all-women leadership team featuring head coach Sandy Brondello, a two-time WNBA champion and the 2014 WNBA Coach of the Year, and general manager Monica Wright Rogers, a two-time WNBA champion, the series captures the relentless race against the clock as they evaluate talent, establish a culture, and lay the foundation for sustained success.
title: Setting the Tempo

overview: Jenni Rivera's life in a household where fame and business collide.
title: I Love Jenni

overview: True crime stories of people fighting convictions they claim are a miscarriage of justice - some after years in prison. Can they overturn their guilty verdict?
title: The Accused: Beyond Reasonable Doubt?

overview: Due to his parents' debts, Paobei, who lost his home, is taken in by Peng, a wealthy heir 12 years his senior, and goes to live in his house. Paobei, who gradually begins to develop romantic feelings for Peng, is suddenly ordered by him to become independent and leave the house, just before his university graduation. Carrying with him the feelings he kept secret for so long, Paobei begins a new phase of his life.
title: Not yours

overview: The main characters of the show "American Groom" are four adult, successful men who are looking for brides. They are Americans of Russian descent, whose families left for the States before the collapse of the USSR. The heroes believe that spoiled, materialistic American women are not suitable as faithful wives, so they move into a luxurious villa in Miami, where they are joined by Russian girls - brides for American grooms. Only sincere feelings can lead the participants to marriage. Each of them has her own story, full of disappointments, failures and mistakes in finding the man of her life. True love, home, family - this is why the girls came to the project "American Groom". Every week, one of them is forced to leave the project, and her place is instantly taken by a new participant. In the finale, the grooms introduce their chosen ones to their parents and make their final decision—to marry the Russian beauty or send her home. The show's host is the world's most famous, curvy Russian model, Katya Zharkova.
title: Американский жених

overview: Intrepid Australians breathe new life into unloved chateaux in France, transforming these breathtaking buildings into dream homes, thriving businesses and family legacies, halfway around the world
title: Château DIY: Australia

overview: Ban Chok Dee is a large, isolated rental house in a remote suburb. The main post of the house was made from a teak tree, which is possessed by a spirit of a nymph. Almost every house usually has one. The wood used to build it also has a ghost. The mystery or origin of each piece of wood tells the story of various people's lives that have been involved in this house. When good people come, the ghost will provide help and protection. But if they are bad, the ghost will harm them. It teaches that doing good deeds brings good results and doing evil things brings bad results.
title: Ban Chok Dee

overview: The one-of-a-kind docuseries offers an eye-opening peek into the world of intimate apparel at Cynthia's and Molly's renowned Atlanta boutique LiviRae Lingerie, where the motto is: "No bust too big or small. We fit them all!" Boasting a hilariously unfiltered cast that exudes Southern charm and hospitality, Double Divas follows Molly and Cynthia displaying their natural talent assisting women with any and all intimate apparel needs. This summer, the program will be bigger and better than ever, as the ladies continue their mission to change the world -- one cup at a time -- starting with none other than Abby Lee Miller, star of Lifetime's hit reality series Dance Moms, who visits LiviRae for a bra-fitting of her own. We'll also meet the Divas' families, including special appearances by Cynthia's father and Molly's fiancé, giving viewers a peek at her trying on wedding dresses in true Double Divas fashion. Plus, the series' charming assistant Loren Schaffer is back and fans will be introduced to new members of the LiviRae staff. And, of course, the ladies will take numerous trips out in the field to work their magic, including a jaw-dropping visit to a nudist resort. In the end, Cynthia and Molly share their heart, soul and laughter with clients - wives, girlfriends, husbands and boyfriends - seeking answers to questions typically reserved for the bedroom.
title: Double Divas

overview: Icebreaker follows Anastasia Allen, a competitive figure skater with her eyes on Olympic gold. Everything changes when Anastasia is forced to share the rink with Nate Hawkins, a hockey player who's equally determined to go pro. Despite the cold temperatures on the ice, the heat between Anastasia and Nate is undeniable. Is ambition or attraction the sharper blade?
title: Icebreaker

overview: The video game industry's premier annual digital showcase and hype campaign.
title: Summer Game Fest

overview: Rick Stein takes us on a culinary journey with this collection, unearthing some hidden gems for all to enjoy.
title: Rick Stein's Tastes of the World

overview: Kings of Coke: New Blood takes audiences into a ruthless biker gang war in the drug trade sparking a deadly underworld power struggle involving the mafia, the West End Gang, and rival crews. As violence spreads, investigators trace the money to a mysterious kingpin known only as Beef. Leading to the takedown of powerful leaders and their massive criminal empires.
title: Kings of Coke: New Blood

overview: He's a genius doctor, until a bullet turns him into a patient. Now, it's up to his team of colleagues to help him recover the last years of his life.
title: Doc

overview: Max and Mauro's story continues. After "Hanno Ucciso l'Uomo Ragno", Nord Sud Ovest Est - La legendaria storia degli 883 shows the events that led to the second album of the band from Pavia, which reached the height of overwhelming success.
title: Nord Sud Ovest Est - La leggendaria storia degli 883

overview: A budding novelist realizes his crime fiction is being used as a blueprint for real-life assassinations by a mysterious organization.
title: Consultant Shi o shippitsu suru otoko

overview: In a quiet Tennessee town, a high school sociology class takes on a mystery that has lingered for decades. Led by teacher Alex Campbell, the students of Elizabethton High School begin investigating the Redhead Murders—a series of unsolved killings that once captured headlines across the South before fading from public memory. What starts as a classroom project soon evolves into a remarkable real-world investigation, as the students uncover new leads, connect long-overlooked clues, and bring fresh attention to victims who were nearly forgotten. Along the way, they discover that the search for answers is about more than solving a case—it's about giving a voice to the people at the center of it and proving that determination can come from the most unexpected places.
title: Murder 101

overview: For the first time, the Lion opens the doors of his castle to fifty players, the most famous faces from television and the world of social media. Completely unaware, they'll confront old grudges, form new relationships, and above all, compete in the arena: the winner chooses which of the losers to eliminate. Only one will triumph, winning the prize money for one of their followers. This is The 50!
title: The 50

overview: Dungeon Masters is a new storytelling experience from D&D where you can play along with the action. In each episode, you'll experience a bold new presentation of D&D storytelling with an original score by five-time Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone, a custom set, cinematic presentation, and elevated production design, all built from material players can actually bring home and make their own.
title: D&D: Dungeon Masters

overview: Wilderness experts confront people living on the edge of survival to make them choose between a professional rescue and continuing to live under dangerous conditions.
title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention

overview: Three Wellington flatmates try to figure out life in their 20s - Flo wants to be a poet, Dee wants to have a good time, and Sadie wants to be perfect. But they seem to be getting in each other's way.
title: Head Girl

overview: Rainbow is a British children's television series, created by Pamela Lonsdale, which ran between five times weekly, twice weekly and once weekly at 12:10 on Tuesdays and Fridays on the ITV network, from 1 September 1972 to 31 December 1992. After more than 1000 episodes, the series came to an abrupt end when Thames Television lost its ITV franchise at the end of 1992. Since then, it has gained cult status and continues to get frequent mentions on radio and television.
title: Rainbow

overview: Janosik - a robber captain like his legendary Slovak role model - lives at a time when the underground rumble of the bourgeois revolution can already be heard on the European continent. The life of the often downtrodden peasants in Poland has become unbearable, and not everyone is willing to accept their fate willingly. In their distress, they not only turn to Janosik to ask for help from the robbers, but quite a few join the gang. After all, the robbers try to realize their ideas of law and justice on their own. They help the poor because they are poor themselves. And so they, witty and courageous fellows as they are, trick the gentlemen quite a few times.
title: Janosik

overview: Set in 1926 Gyeongseong during Japanese occupation that follows the story of Kang Ui Hyeon, a man who dedicates everything to his country, and Su A, a woman who risks her life to protect him. A Korean reimaging of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid."
title: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid

overview: Set in the cutthroat world of New York City real estate, The Pinnacle is the story of ambitious and streetsmart Charlie Mahoney, who is catapulted to the heart of the billionaire Van Buren family and their dazzling penthouse on New York's Billionaire's Row after becoming the sobriety companion to their troubled son, Theo. As he gains their trust and acclimates to their sumptuous lifestyle, Charlie must navigate scheming staff, suspicious friends and romantic entanglements while hiding a secret of his own and securing his permanent place in New York's ultra wealthy circles.
title: The Pinnacle

overview: The Silver Theatre is a live dramatic anthology series that aired on the CBS television network from 1949 to 1950. Rather than having a single overarching narrative, it featured stand-alone episodes focusing on the humorous, silly, frustrating, and rewarding aspects of romance. Each 30-minute episode starred a different rotating cast of prominent Hollywood actors and was sponsored by the International Silver Company.
title: The Silver Theatre
